tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. Storyflow's off-white in light, Storyflow's charcoal in dark (the website).

tokens.name: ground-deep
tokens.usage: Alternate sections, the Board view canvas, the outputs list.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, the open output, the assistant.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons, hovered rows, inputs.

tokens.name: tint-1
tokens.usage: Faint wash over a surface, such as a feature panel on the website.

tokens.name: tint-2
tokens.usage: Hover wash, waiting chips, the inactive stage bar track.

tokens.name: tint-3
tokens.usage: Pressed and selected wash.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders around cards and between rows.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Dividers that must be seen, the board card being written.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs and outlined buttons and chips. Meets 3:1 on surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body text on ground and surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Supporting text, navigation links, card excerpts.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Captions, placeholders, future stages. Not for long text.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The main pill button and filled chips: charcoal in light, off-white in dark, as on Storyflow and Expo.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Storyflow's orange. Rare: only the single most important call to action on a screen (Start your project, Generate) and the small New dot. Never for text, borders or status.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on accent. White fails contrast, so always black.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring, offset 2px, on every interactive element.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Tell us about your video. You can type or record a voice note.

styles.name: body-ar
styles.sample: اكتب فكرة الفيديو أو سجل رسالة صوتية
styles.usage: Arabic running text. One size up and more leading than body.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase labels on cards, stage numbers, the walkthrough counter (01 / 07). Latin only; in Arabic use small.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Shot numbers, timecodes, costs in tables.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside chips and between tight controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between rows in lists.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding and the phone side gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards and panels.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Padding of large panels.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Space between page sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Space between website sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, inputs, small tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, the board cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Modals, large media frames, website feature panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Every button and the stage bar segments.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Board cards and floating panels only. Page cards use a line border.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Menus, the model picker popover, the AI cursor tag.
